mechanics.claim: Qiyana dashes a fixed distance toward the target; damage is dealt on arrival only if the target is still in range.
mechanics.quote: dashes a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy. If they are in range upon arrival, she deals {{as|physical damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The damage only lands if the target is within 250 range when the dash finishes, not the full 650 cast range.
mechanics.quote: ''Audacity'' only damages targets if within 250 range upon completion of the dash.

mechanics.claim: Qiyana automatically attacks the target as soon as the dash completes, which can trigger on-hit effects and reset her attack timer.
mechanics.quote: '''Qiyana''' will automatically be ordered to [[Basic attack#Acquisition|acquire]] and attack ''Audacity's'' target as soon as the dash completes.

mechanics.claim: Qiyana can cast any of her other abilities during the E dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Qiyana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.

mechanics.claim: Audacity's dash speed increases with Qiyana's movement speed, capped at a maximum.
There is no cast time for Audacity.
